## What changes for the person using InboxCraft

## How it was checked

- [ ] `cargo xtask ci` passes
- [ ] A crash or data-loss fix comes with a regression test
- [ ] No real mailbox, passwords or tokens in tests or fixtures
- [ ] The change is recorded in `changes/<issue>.md` (CHANGELOG, ROADMAP, new gaps lines, revision rows)
- [ ] "Allow edits by maintainers" is ticked
